recipes.title: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
recipes.description: A rich and creamy risotto with earthy mushrooms and parmesan.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add 1 chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes until soft.
Stir in 250g sliced mushrooms and 2 minced garlic cloves; cook for 5 minutes.
Add 1 cup arborio rice and stir for 2 minutes until translucent.
Pour in 4 cups vegetable broth gradually, stirring continuously until absorbed.
Stir in 2 tbsp butter and 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese until melted.
Garnish with 2 tbsp chopped parsley before serving.

recipes.title: Classic Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.description: A hearty, comforting bowl of chicken noodle soup with tender veggies and herbs.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add 1 diced onion, 2 sliced carrots, and 2 chopped celery stalks; sauté for 5 minutes.
Stir in 2 minced garlic cloves and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add 300g boneless chicken thighs, 6 cups chicken broth, 1 tsp dried thyme, and 2 bay leaves.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook for 20 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Remove chicken, shred it, and return it to the pot.
Add 100g egg noodles and cook for 8-10 minutes until al dente.
Season with salt and pepper to taste before serving.

recipes.title: Vegetable Biryani
recipes.description: A fragrant Indian spiced rice dish with colorful vegetables and aromatic herbs.
instructions: Wash and soak 1.5 cups basmati rice in water for 30 minutes; drain.
Heat 3 tbsp vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add 1 thinly sliced onion and sauté for 5-7 minutes until golden brown.
Stir in 3 minced garlic cloves and 1 inch grated ginger; cook for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add 2 cups mixed vegetables, 2 tbsp biryani masala, 1 tsp ground cumin, and 1 tsp ground coriander; sauté.
Mix in drained rice, 3 cups water, and salt to taste; bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer over low heat for 20-25 minutes until rice is cooked and water absorbed.
Fluff with a fork and mix in chopped mint and cilantro before serving.

recipes.title: Chickpea Salad Wrap
recipes.description: A refreshing and protein-packed wrap with zesty flavors.
instructions: Drain 1 can of chickpeas and rinse them well under cold water.
Chop 1 cucumber, 1 red bell pepper, and 1/4 red onion into small pieces.
Combine the chickpeas, cucumber, red bell pepper, red onion, and 1/4 cup parsley in a bowl.
Drizzle 2 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tbsp olive oil over the mixture, then season with salt and pepper.
Spoon the chickpea mixture onto 2 whole wheat tortillas and roll them up tightly.
Serve the wraps immediately or slice them in half for easier eating.

recipes.title: Thai Mango Salad
recipes.description: Bright and tangy, this salad bursts with tropical flavors and crunch.
instructions: Dice 1 ripe mango, and grate 1 medium carrot into a large bowl.
Shred 2 cups of cabbage and thinly slice 1 red bell pepper into the bowl.
Add 1/4 cup chopped cilantro and toss everything together gently.
In a separate bowl, whisk together 3 tbsp lime juice, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp peanut butter, and 2 tbsp water until smooth.
Pour the dressing over the salad, season with salt, and toss well to combine.
Garnish with 1/4 cup chopped peanuts before serving for extra crunch.

recipes.title: Zucchini Noodle Stir-fry
recipes.description: A flavorful veggie noodle dish with a savory sauce and crunch.
instructions: Spiralize 2 medium zucchinis and julienne 1 carrot into a bowl and set aside.
Heat 1 tbsp of sesame oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add 2 cloves of minced garlic and 1 inch minced ginger, stir-frying until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Stir in 1 sliced red bell pepper and 1 cup snow peas, cooking for 5 minutes until tender.
Add the spiralized zucchini, julienned carrot, and 3 tbsp soy sauce, stirring well for another 5 minutes.
Season to taste with salt, then garnish with toasted sesame seeds and sliced scallions before serving.
Serve warm and enjoy your healthy noodle stir-fry!

recipes.title: Korean Bibimbap
recipes.description: Savor a colorful bowl of rice topped with seasoned vegetables and beef.
instructions: Prepare 2 cups of cooked rice in advance and keep warm.
Thinly slice 150g beef and marinate with 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp sesame oil for 10 minutes.
Sauté the marinated beef for 5 minutes over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through.
Blanch 1 cup of spinach in salted boiling water, then drain and squeeze out excess water.
Julienne 1 large carrot and 1 medium zucchini and sauté each separately for 3 minutes in sesame oil over medium heat until tender.
Fry 1 egg sunny-side up in a little oil over low heat until the whites are set.
Assemble the bibimbap: layer rice, veggies, beef, and top with the fried egg, sesame seeds, and gochujang.

recipes.title: Chickpea Shawarma Wraps
recipes.description: Flavorful spiced chickpeas wrapped in soft pita with fresh veggies.
instructions: Drain and rinse 1 can of chickpeas and pat dry with paper towels.
Toss chickpeas with 2 tbsp tahini, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and cook the seasoned chickpeas for 5 minutes until fragrant.
Chop 1 cucumber, 1 tomato, and 1 red onion for the wraps.
Layer 1 cup of lettuce, chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, and red onion in each pita.
Wrap the pitas tightly and serve immediately with extra tahini if desired.

recipes.title: Thai Green Curry with Chicken
recipes.description: A rich and fragrant curry with tender chicken and assorted vegetables.
instructions: Cook 1 cup of jasmine rice according to package instructions and set aside when done.
Slice 300g chicken breast into bite-size pieces and season with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 cup of coconut milk over medium heat in a large saucepan until steaming but not boiling.
Add 2 tbsp green curry paste to the coconut milk and simmer for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in the seasoned chicken, 1 sliced bell pepper, 1 sliced carrot, and 100g green beans; cook for 15 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Season with 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tsp sugar, and stir in 1/2 cup basil leaves before serving.
Serve the green curry over the prepared jasmine rice and garnish with extra basil if desired.

recipes.title: Classic Chicken Alfredo
recipes.description: Creamy homemade Alfredo sauce over fettuccine and grilled chicken.
instructions: Boil 200g fettuccine in salted water until al dente, about 10 minutes, then drain.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil over medium heat, then sauté 300g chicken breast for 6-7 minutes until golden brown.
Add 2 cloves minced garlic to the pan and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in 1 cup heavy cream, and add 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, stirring until melted and smooth.
Slice cooked chicken, then combine with drained fettuccine and Alfredo sauce, mixing well.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste, and garnish with parsley before serving.

recipes.title: Vegetable Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Quick and colorful vegetable stir-fry with soy sauce over rice.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil over high heat in a large pan, then add 1 cup broccoli.
Add 1 large chopped carrot, 1 chopped bell pepper, and 1 cup snap peas, stirring frequently for 5 minutes.
Pour in 2 tbsp soy sauce and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes until well-coated.
Serve vegetable stir-fry over 2 cups cooked rice, garnishing with sesame seeds if desired.

recipes.title: Savory Beef Pot Pie
recipes.description: Rich beef and vegetable filling encased in a flaky crust, perfect for comfort.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat, then brown 1 kg beef chuck for 5-7 minutes.
Add 1 chopped onion, 2 diced carrots, and 2 diced celery stalks, then cook for 5 minutes.
Incorporate 2 minced cloves of garlic, cooking for an additional minute until fragrant.
Sprinkle 3 tbsp flour, 1 tsp thyme, and 1 tsp rosemary over the mixture and stir well.
Pour in 1 cup beef broth and stir in 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste, then let mixture cool slightly.
Transfer filling into a pie dish and cover with 1 pie crust, sealing edges.
Bake in oven at 200°C for 30-35 minutes until crust is golden brown.
